scope: GitHub boundary acceptance evidence provenance, not production CLI or Discord acceptance.

red.failure: Old driver reached the GitHub boundary with missing/mismatched artifact or unbound completed stage.

guarantees: Version-2 checkpoints bind test artifact SHA-256 and byte length.
Completed stages bind the same artifact and exact log hash.
Legacy checkpoints and unbound stages refuse before any GitHub operation; historical files remain untouched.
Linux executable FD pins the tested inode across path replacement; in-place changes refuse dispatch.
Final result includes tested artifact identity.
limits: Tests use a refusing GitHub executable and local subprocess fixtures; no repositories or PRs were created.
No claim of current-build remote merge, normal rollout, provider readiness, Discord coding or soak.
Historical archived acceptance repositories are not unarchived or relabeled as current proof.
